verdict.rationale: The MI355X ships with fleet-management tooling (AMD SMI, GPU Operator, cluster validation), so bulk operations across many GPUs is a fair question for this product. However, no evidence documents a bulk or batch operation that acts on many items at once. The docs describe managing, monitoring and deploying GPUs only in general terms, which is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
